transcript: Four ingredients that leave your mouth clean in three days. Nobody tells you this because mouthwash brands don't want you to find out. Put warm water in a glass, squeeze half a lemon, add a tablespoon of baking soda and a tablespoon of salt, swish it around for a minute and spit it out. Never swallow it, do it every morning on an empty stomach. The warm water opens the gum tissue and allows the ingredients to penetrate deeper. The lemon disinfects and eliminates the bacteria that cause bad breath. The baking soda neutralizes the acidity in your mouth, which is the environment where bacteria multiply, and the salt sweeps away food debris trapped between your teeth and gums where your toothbrush can't reach. In three days your mouth feels brand new, bad breath disappears, bacteria are reduced, gums become less inflamed and your mouth feels fresher than it has in months. A recipe our grandparents used every morning that fell into oblivion when the industry started selling you rinses full of alcohol and chemicals saved this recipe. But I want you to understand something, bad breath doesn't always come from the mouth. In Chinese medicine the mouth reflects the state of the stomach and the intestines. When your digestion is slow and your intestine is inflamed, the gases it produces rise up and come out through your mouth as bad breath.
